description:
AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

Retire the legacy release path after dlv2-52 completes the first new-path PyPI release. Paths corrected 2026-10-17: guide is docs/internal/release-guide.md; ADR is docs/internal/adr/adr-dev-loop-v2.md. The rehearse-release-isolation.yml shared deletion with site-split-51 is removed: the file does not exist and site-split-51-publication-retirement is done (codex/claude F3 confirmed). dlv2-53 also lists tests/unit/workflows/test_release_isolation, which does not exist; tests/unit/release/test_changelog_tag_guard.py does exist and must be accounted for (claude F3).

Decision gates (all must hold before any deletion):
- GATE A (fallback retired): dlv2-52 finished (first PyPI release on release-v2 verified). Until then ADR G7 keeps the legacy path fully working; no trigger narrowing, no workflow/script deletion (codex F9(1a)).
- GATE B (property ledger): docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md classifies release.yml, release-canary.yml, test.yml, validate-release-pr.yml and the release tests as product-safety. Each deleted property needs replacement evidence in release-v2/nightly before deletion (codex F10 Required).
- GATE C (drift decoupling): scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py parse_expected_rulesets hard-codes release-only (:153). The runbook plus script change removing that expectation must merge BEFORE ruleset 19149459 is deleted, or every later drift gate fails (claude NEW-5). Post-retirement drift validation must pass without overrides.
- GATE D (ruleset 15611787): owner decision on v-release-branches-minimal. Recommendation after review: keep it until the fallback is retired, then delete with 19149459, or convert it to a creation block on refs/heads/v* so a branch cannot share a name with a tag (claude F9(5)); validate-release-pr.yml still requires vX.Y.Z release branches until GATE A. Record the owner's answer; do not delete on agent judgment.
- GATE E (single ownership): the release branch deletion is owned by this item alone (archive tag archive/release-<date> at the branch tip first, G5 backups). dlv2-80 cross-references it and must not list it as its own step (claude NEW-10).

Work (after gates): trigger flip (release-v2 becomes the v* tag publisher; legacy release.yml removed or narrowed per the flip plan), delete .github/workflows/{test.yml, lint.yml, perf-smoke.yml, validate-release-pr.yml, release-canary.yml}, .github/RELEASE_PR_TEMPLATE.md, scripts/{release_cut_start.sh, release_cut_abort.sh, release_finalize.py, release_canary_incident.py, release_canary_sharding.py}, Makefile release-cut/release-cut-abort/release-finalize, and the listed tests, each re-checked against the live tree at execution time. Sweep references: ci.yml branches-ignore (now ci.yml:10, no INTEGRATION_BRANCHES remains), AGENTS.md (now :93), CONTRIBUTING.md (now :50 and :281-291), the Makefile release-cut strip list, and the benchbox skill release triggers in the skill-sync source. Rewrite docs/internal/release-guide.md. Re-verify every listed path exists before deleting; a missing path is recorded, not an error.

Owner/admin steps (separate from code PRs, G5 backups first): archive tag, delete branch release, delete rulesets per GATE C/D. Keep: v-tag-restricted (as amended by v-tag-ruleset-allows-tag-moves-20261009), pypi and test-pypi environments, update_version.py, generate_changelog_entry.py, check_dependency_bounds.py.
